caption: Fixes #1748: a routing deep block now rounds a hill in its way as one body. An 80-horse squadron, already broken, flees south (down the screen) toward a hill that stands across the eastern half of its block. Its flight swings west wide enough for the whole block to pass, and the men on its eastern files run past the hill rather than into it; the two front-rank riders that reach the hill's face first slide along it and off its corner at the block's own pace. Before the fix the flight cleared only the centre of the block: the eastern files ran into the hill's face and were held there (12 men against it by the end of this clip) while the rest ran on, the block stretched, and over a longer flight the held men slowed the whole rout to under 60 percent of its pace. The clip ends just before the rout timer runs out and the squadron rallies.
